title: Claim
description: A single assertion attributed to a source, with mandatory verbatim evidence. A claim with no evidence is not representable in this schema.

_comment.description: Free-text annotation, ignored by all tooling. Allowed so that copied templates do not fail validation on an unexpected key.

claim_id.description: Content-addressed: derived from the statement plus its evidence segment IDs, so an edited claim cannot silently keep an old ID.

statement.description: The assertion in the KB author's words. This is a paraphrase for indexing; the evidence quotes are the authority.

evidence.description: At least one grounded quote. Enforced by schema AND re-verified against the corpus by `ictkb validate`.

quote.description: MUST appear verbatim (whitespace-normalised, case-insensitive) inside the referenced segment's text. `ictkb validate` fails the build otherwise.

confidence.description: high = explicit and unambiguous in a manual-caption segment; medium = explicit but auto-captioned or paraphrased across segments; low = inferred.

contradicts.description: Claim IDs this one conflicts with. Sources contradict themselves and each other over time; the distiller refuses to build a rule on an unresolved contradiction.

method.description: llm_proposed claims are untrusted until a human promotes them; the distiller ignores them by default.
